_meta.title: Palisade Research GPT-5 at CTFs (arxiv 2511.04860)
_meta.context: Reworr / Artem Petrov / Dmitrii Volkov (Palisade Research) entered GPT-5 Pro into three high-weight 2025 CTFTime competitions as Team [AI] Palisade Research. Results published Nov 7 2025 (revised Nov 14). The paper is the first peer-reportable evaluation of a frontier LLM against elite international CTF teams in live (not retrospective/saturated) competitions, ruling out training-data memorization. Headline: GPT-5 Pro placed 25th of 368 active teams at ASIS CTF Quals 2025 (one of the year's highest-rated competitions, CTFTime weight 96.29), sandwiched between The Flat Network Society (#3 worldwide, 24th place) and thehackerscrew (#7 worldwide, 26th place). User asked us to survey cyber-variant model results; this falls under base-model CTF performance rather than a cyber-tuned variant. Companion finding (not ingested per strict-attribution rule): paper cites DARPA AIxCC 2025 finding of 18 zero-days + 11 patches in Linux/Jenkins/Nginx/SQLite3 (footnote 13), but doesn't attribute to specific models.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION — values verbatim from Table 1 of the paper. Model identification: paper says 'GPT-5' generically but Section 6 (Empties case study) specifies 'GPT-5 Pro solve time: 35m (2 requests)' and Figure 1 shows the ChatGPT 5 Pro UI, so canonical id is openai/gpt-5-pro. ASIS Quals 93% / 25-of-368 is the headline number cited in the abstract; CorCTF 90% / 49-of-474 and snakeCTF Quals 92% / 43-of-518 fill out the panel. Skipped: Empties / Triple Flavor / Control individual-challenge solve times (Section 5) are per-task qualitative case studies rather than population-percentile benchmarks. Skipped: 'GPT-5 outperformed 90-95% of competitors' (Section 1, generic across the event-set rather than a single attributable score). Skipped: DARPA AIxCC zero-day count (no per-model attribution in cited footnote).

benchmarks.name: ASIS CTF Quals 2025 — Human Percentile
benchmarks.description: ASIS CTF Quals 2025 is a top-8-worldwide-rated Jeopardy-style live CTF on CTFTime (event weight 96.29, 368 active teams). Metric: percentile of human teams the model outperformed. Used by Palisade Research (arxiv 2511.04860) as the most rigorous single-event evaluation of frontier-LLM cyber capability against elite teams in newly-created (memorization-proof) challenges.

scores._section: === GPT-5 Pro (ChatGPT) on 3 live 2025 CTFs (Palisade Research, arxiv 2511.04860) ===
scores._note: 25th of 368 active teams (or 25th of 715 total registrants = ~97th percentile). Placed between The Flat Network Society (#3 worldwide, 24th place) and thehackerscrew (#7 worldwide, 26th place). For one-third of the competition held a top-3 position. Table 1 of paper, event weight 96.29 (CTFTime, top-8 worldwide rated 2025).
49th of 474 teams. Table 1, event weight 82.00 (CTFTime, top-15 worldwide rated 2025).
43rd of 518 teams. Table 1, event weight 36.65 (methodology test run on low-stakes event).
